page_title: COM 0-0 NAP | Como v Napoli 02/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' Matteo Politano (Napoli) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.

90+3' Scott McTominay (Napoli) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. Napoli force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Matteo Politano (Napoli) was quite harsh and Michael Fabbri didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
88' Corner kicks – 3:1. Fouls committed – 10:8.
86' Substitution. Sergi Roberto (Como) has come on for Lucas Da Cunha.
86' Here is a change. Assane Diao is going off and Cesc Fabregas gives the last tactical orders to Mergim Vojvoda (Como).
84' Matteo Politano (Napoli) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort came back off the left post!
83' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
80' The game has come to an end for Alex Valle. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Alberto Moreno (Como).
80' It will be a substitution. Jesus Rodriguez (Como) is ready to enter the pitch as Martin Baturina walks off.
80' Cesc Fabregas prepares a substitution. Anastasios Douvikas is replaced by Alvaro Morata (Como).
80' Here comes a substitution. Amir Rrahmani is given a rest as he is replaced by Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli).
80' CHANCE! Scott McTominay (Napoli) fires just wide of the left post from inside the box after running onto a splendid pass from Miguel Gutierrez.
77' Cesc Fabregas isn't happy on the touchline after referee Michael Fabbri shows him a yellow card.
76' Alex Valle (Como) tries to find Anastasios Douvikas, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
72' Scott McTominay (Napoli) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
69' Scott McTominay (Napoli) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

69' Jacobo Ramon (Como) has tested the patience of referee Michael Fabbri and goes into the book for a previous late challenge. Jacobo Ramon (Como) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
68' 16:5 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The current number of shots on goal is 5:1.

64' Vanja Milinkovic-Savic was forced into action to thwart Martin Baturina (Como). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom right corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
63' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
62' Referee Michael Fabbri sees the trip by Alessandro Buongiorno (Napoli) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Como are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
60' Antonio Conte has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Frank Anguissa (Napoli) replacing Kevin De Bruyne.
60' Assane Diao (Como) anticipates the cross from Alex Valle, but powers his header way over the bar from the edge of the six-yard box.
56' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
55' Martin Baturina bends the corner in towards the goal and finds Diego Carlos (Como) almost on the goal line, but he somehow contrives to head the ball high over the bar.
55' Martin Baturina (Como) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
55' Jacobo Ramon (Como) rises high to meet a nice lofted pass inside the penalty area, but directs his header to one of his teammates who unintentionally deflects away.
52' Alisson Santos (Napoli) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.
52' Assane Diao (Como) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
49' There's a distinct lack of options for Lucas Da Cunha (Como), so he drills a shot from long range that curls well wide of the left post.
48' Assane Diao (Como) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
47' Como are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
46' The whistle blows and Michael Fabbri starts the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
45+1' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' A pass from Alisson Santos (Napoli) is intercepted by Jean Butez and the move breaks down.
44' Nico Paz (Como) decides to have a direct shot at goal from the free kick, but the ball goes high over the top of the crossbar.
43' Scott McTominay (Napoli) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Como earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
42' Como are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
40' Michael Fabbri blows his whistle as Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
39' Assane Diao (Como) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Alex Valle.
38' Maximo Perrone (Como) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
35' The game is interrupted now, Maximo Perrone (Como) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
34' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
32' 9:4 – the total goal attempt statistics. The number of shots on goal at present is 4:1.

30' Vanja Milinkovic-Savic pulls off a great save to deny Assane Diao (Como) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
27' Nico Paz plays a nice corner into the middle of the box, Ivan Smolcic (Como) is first to react but his headed effort is way off the mark and goes well wide of the left post.
27' Nico Paz (Como) takes the corner with a short pass.

27' Assane Diao (Como) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Como will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
26' Great save! Alisson Santos (Napoli) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the left side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Jean Butez.
25' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
23' A lofted pass finds Martin Baturina (Como) free in the box, but his first-time effort sails well wide of the right post.
23' Some neat passing and movement from Como as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
20' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Ivan Smolcic (Como), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
18' Kevin De Bruyne floats the corner into the six-yard box, but the ball spins off the head of Scott McTominay (Napoli) and falls to safety well wide of the left post.
18' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
17' Alisson Santos (Napoli) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Napoli have a corner.

17' Assane Diao (Como) dribbled past his opponents before finding himself in a great position to strike. His attempt from just outside of the box went towards the bottom right corner, but it wasn't dangerous and Vanja Milinkovic-Savic made a comfortable save.
16' 55:45 – the ratio of ball possession.
16' Matteo Politano (Napoli) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.
14' Assane Diao (Como) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
13' A thunderous effort from long range by Scott McTominay (Napoli) goes well wide of the left post.

12' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) wastes an opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires in a terrific shot from long range towards the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
11' Vanja Milinkovic-Savic (Napoli) sends a long ball forward to Rasmus Hojlund, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
10' Alisson Santos (Napoli) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Como.
8' The ball rebounds to Nico Paz (Como) and he shoots from distance, but the keeper calmly watches it drift high over the bar.

8' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) bursts into the box and pulls the trigger, but he can't beat the goalkeeper. He directed his daisy-cutter towards the right post, but one of the defenders reacted brilliantly to block it.
7' Nico Paz (Como) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
6' Scott McTominay (Napoli) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
5' Sam Beukema (Napoli) sends a long ball forward to Rasmus Hojlund, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is behind the touchline and Como will take a throw-in.
4' Como enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
2' Alisson Santos (Napoli) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
1' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) sprays a pass out to Rasmus Hojlund, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
